parameters.content:
# Odoo Company Executive Enricher

## Purpose
Automatically discover and add key executives (CEO, CTO, CDO, CIO, CSO, Board Members) to companies in Odoo that lack contact information.

## Target Executives
- CEO / Chief Executive Officer
- CTO / Chief Technology Officer
- CDO / Chief Digital Officer / Chief Data Officer
- CIO / Chief Information Officer
- CSO / Chief Sales Officer / Chief Strategy Officer
- CFO / Chief Financial Officer
- COO / Chief Operating Officer
- CMO / Chief Marketing Officer
- Founders / Co-Founders / Owners
- Vice Presidents (VP)
- Directors
- Board Members

## Features
✅ Searches executives by company name
✅ Ranks by seniority (C-Suite → VP → Director)
✅ Creates contacts directly in Odoo
✅ Links contacts to parent company
✅ Captures LinkedIn URLs and emails
✅ Avoids duplicate enrichment (60-day cooldown)
✅ Respects API rate limits (10s delay)

## Requirements

### Proxycurl API
- Employee search endpoint
- Cost: ~$0.30-0.50 per company search
- Max 20 companies per monthly run = $10/month

### Odoo Custom Fields
On res.partner:
- x_linkedin_url
- x_last_enriched
- x_needs_enrichment
- x_enrichment_source
- x_seniority_level
- x_enrichment_notes

## Cost Estimation
20 companies × $0.50 = $10/month
+ Creating contacts (free)
= ~$10-15/month total

## Enrichment Flow

1. Fetch companies without contacts
2. Search for executives via Proxycurl
3. Rank by seniority (CEO > CTO > VP...)
4. Take top 5 executives per company
5. Create contacts in Odoo
6. Link to parent company
7. Mark company as enriched

Data Captured:
- Full name
- Job title
- LinkedIn URL
- Email (if available)
- Seniority level
- Location
- Summary/Bio
